text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Dantsu's Umastagram.
'I'll be taking a short break from the Twinkle Series
for a recuperation trip'... it says."

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that? A recuperation trip... where to?
As for Dantsu Flame, who had stirred up a quiet buzz among the public—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho...!

Through an introduction from a fellow trainer, I had come
to a specialized sanatorium for Umamusume located in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I've finished mowing over there!

text_block_list.name: Ranch Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Dantsu-chan!
Thank you, that really helps a lot.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Not at all, thank you! It was great exercise, so I'm grateful for it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Today was
so much fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"It really is a wonderful place.
Surrounded by so much nature, and the air is so fresh!"
choice_data_list: I'm glad you seem to be having fun.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thank you so much
for bringing me somewhere so fun!

This time, after undergoing cutting-edge surgery recommended by the doctor,
she spent her recuperation focused on mental care
in addition to physical rehabilitation.

"I explained to her that it was to improve her healing capabilities,
but the truth was, I wanted to create an environment where she could make decisions about her future with a calm mind."
choice_data_list: (So far, so good.)

text_block_list.text:
It would be good if she could face her own heart
without getting impatient, but……
With such prayers in her heart, the days of her medical recuperation passed quietly by.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Slowly, slowly... don't rush...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright, once more...

text_block_list.name: Rehabilitation Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Please focus your attention on your breathing.
Inhale, exhale. Just breathe naturally.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Ranch Staff
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dantsu-chan.
I wish you could just stay here forever.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I'm so happy!
I love this place too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh, are you... a fan of mine!?

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! No matter how strong the rival,
or if the distance isn't my strong suit, seeing her give her all
without ever giving up always gives me courage!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah―― I-I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, I won't be running in the public spotlight like the Twinkle Series anymore...

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"My legs gave out on me. Going forward,
I plan to focus primarily on freestyle racing.
...I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I was a little surprised, but...
thank you for telling me!

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, your sudden leave for medical treatment had me worried.
If you could tell me the reason, and what's next...
it'd be a lot easier to take in, you know?

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I'll keep cheering you on.
Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah...,
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (To have you say that to me...)

Perhaps the environment enhanced her natural healing, but Dantsu Flame's leg recovered faster than expected.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Can I really enter next weekend's Freestyle Race?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, at this rate, it should be fine.
Yeah, at this rate, it looks like you'll be fine, so...

text_block_list.text:
It's not like the top-level, fierce competition
you'd see in the Twinkle Series.

I thought she should experience it at least once,
as a touchstone for welcoming
the new days ahead.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Understood, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I've gotta give it my all...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: *inhale*... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ‘I remember now, "Dants Flame"!!’

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah... S-Sorry...!
I somehow lost my concentration for a second—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Once more, please!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......
I'll do my best in the freestyle race...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (If I do my best, produce results, and truly shine, I'm sure I won't ever think back on it again...!)
And finally, the day of the Freestyle Race arrived.

As a GⅠ veteran who came from the Twinkle Series,
Dantsu Flame drew a massive amount of attention—

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And now—they all burst out together!
Oh, and leading the pack as expected is Dantsu Flame!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, phew!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable speed for a comeback race!
So this is the power of a Twinkle Series veteran~~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but it seems her time away showed! A fierce battle to the wire!
Dantsu Flame falls just short in second place--!!

A brisk commentary and wild cheers enveloped her.
Although she finished in second place,
the undeniable star of this race was her.
choice_data_list: (Thank goodness, I managed to finish the race safely...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I did it, I ran...!
I knew it, if it's here—!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (H-Huh? Why—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Why does my chest... hurt this much――?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: Good work, Dantsu—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Listen to this!
Maybe it's because I held back in the race,
but my legs feel completely, totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If we keep up this pace of recovery and training,
we'll definitely get great results in the next freestyle race too! A huge success!

...Dantsu Flame spoke of her joy without hesitation.
While finding the sight heartwarming—
I felt a slight sense of unease.

Strong, assertive phrasing, quite unusual for her.
A fluency that allows no room for rebuttal—
It seemed as though she was trying to convince herself that nothing was wrong with the current situation.
choice_data_list: ...Dantsu, are you really okay with this?
...Dantsu, are you really sure?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Are you really sure about a freestyle race?
Are you really sure about a freestyle race?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“......Yes......
The results weren't bad,
and the crowd was really hyped up, so—”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Today was so much fun.
If it's here, I'm sure―
choice_data_list: Really?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: Are you really satisfied with just being able to keep running?
Are you really satisfied with just being able to keep running?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That is...

True. In freestyle racing, even without running so hard that you burn yourself out,
you can probably still achieve decent results.

"Without fearing the recurrence of leg issues,
I can simply keep my thoughts on the leading role
that I might someday reach."
choice_data_list: Still, your dream is—
Still, your dream is—

text_block_list.text:
For instance, a brilliance that lingers deep within many hearts.
For instance, the absolute protagonist shining brightest on the grandest stage.
It was such a dazzling light—

Was it not a blazing flame,
rather than a gentle patch of sunlight?
choice_data_list: I want to know the true feelings deep within your heart.
I want to know the true feelings in the depths of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I—
(UOOOOOOOOH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh.
choice_data_list: Dantsu, you really are—
Dantsu, you really are—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I... I was,
I was trying to swallow it!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the harder I try to forget,
the more I say I've given up, the more and more I run,
no matter where I go, no matter what I do—”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, you're wrong...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: My heart was racing, aching, completely beyond my control—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I've been keeping a lid on it... this whole time...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If it's not that place, I can't reach it.
I really, truly...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Twinkle Series!
...I feel like I've finally heard her true thoughts.

Even though she wears a pained expression,
for some reason, it brings a sense of relief.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, got it.
...Yeah, got it.

text_block_list.text: Let's restructure the treatment plan and race rotation toward a return to the Twinkle Series. The difficulty might be desperate. Even so—
choice_data_list: Let's make our comeback in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.text:
Even so, I will claim it there without fail.
The "leading role" that I could never give up on!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes!
